why: Critic-107 round 3 fixes, coordinator-triaged. shipping#4 gains trunk-ancestor-before-merge (fetch trunk before each merge; a tip that is not an ancestor of the verified head stops that pull request for updating and a fresh verdict). The receipts are those of the latest verdict for the tree, which must be PASS or PASS+NOTES, keyed verdict <pr>@<tree sha>#<n>. The child move stops on merge commits between the old parent tip and the snapshot head. A pull request whose parent already merged gets the move at intake before its verdict is checked. New one-line scope: branch-based stacks in this repository only, forge-managed stacks reported unsupported before any verdict is posted, fork heads stop before any move. New stated limit: one babysitter or shipper per stack.
